## Change

Describe the user-visible or operational change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Required CI checks pass on the latest revision.
- [ ] Relevant allowed, denied, invalid, concurrent and retry cases are covered.
- [ ] UI changes preserve French labels, permissions and Approved V3; desktop/mobile states checked.
- [ ] Migrations preserve existing data; recovery impact reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, real client data, private files or generated test artifacts are included.
- [ ] Contracts/runbooks and remaining limitations are updated.
